entity: South Carolina Department of Parks, Recreation, and Tourism
role: State agency providing trail rating classification
stance_basis: trail rating classification cited as factual reference with no expressed support or opposition
summary: The South Carolina Department of Parks, Recreation, and Tourism is referenced solely as the source of a trail rating classification system used to characterize the difficulty of the proposed hiking trail. The agency's rating system indicates most of the proposed trail would be classified as 'D' or 'Difficult,' consistent with trails in the adjacent Table Rock State Park. No position for or against the project is attributed to the agency.
complaint_summary: The South Carolina Department of Parks, Recreation, and Tourism's trail rating system is cited to classify most of the proposed hiking trail as 'D' or 'Difficult,' noting an extreme variety of terrain and rugged walking surfaces, with the same rating applying to all trails in the adjacent Table Rock State Park.
summary_quote: On the basis of the trail rating system used by the South Carolina Department of Parks, Recreation, and Tourism, most of the proposed trail would be classified as "D" or "Difficult," with an "extreme variety of terrain and rugged walking surfaces.
